title: Dashcam
subject: a two-second near-miss on a dashcam you keep reopening at night
caption: Melodic R&B-rap with autotune used as a texture rather than a correction. Filtered 808 bass with the top end rolled off, a pitched-up chopped vocal sample as the recurring motif, sparse muted electric piano chords, dry rimshot and sparse claps instead of a busy hat pattern, long empty bars. Hazy and narrow mix, everything slightly blurred, heavy autotune on the hook and lighter on the verses. Male voice, conversational and numb in the verses, fully autotuned and melodic on the hook with wide harmony stacks. 76 BPM, B minor. Numb and circling. No aggressive trap hi-hat rolls, no live drums, no shouting, no triumphant turn.
lyrics:
[Intro - filtered 808 and pitched vocal]

[Verse 1]
Camera on the windshield caught the whole thing, two seconds, maybe less
White sedan comes through the red and I'm already past where it would have been
I didn't even brake. Didn't have the time to be scared.
Got scared at eleven at night, three days later, watching it back

[Hook - heavy autotune]
I keep the clip, I don't know why
Forty megabytes of almost
Everybody I love is in that car with me in every version but this one
I watch it, then I close it, then I open it again

[Verse 2]
Told nobody for a week, then told everybody in one night
My brother said "that's wild", then started talking about his car
That's fine. That's normal. I wanted it to be bigger than it was.
It was two seconds. It just took up a whole year of room.

[Hook - heavy autotune]
I keep the clip, I don't know why
Forty megabytes of almost
Everybody I love is in that car with me in every version but this one
I watch it, then I close it, then I leave it closed

[Bridge - beat out, voice alone]
Bought new tires I did not need
That was the only thing I could do with it

[Outro - 808 fades]
Two seconds
Still driving
Still slower at that light
